sessions.title: Cycle Catalog + Defaults + Controller Pipeline Wiring

smart_config.role: CNC Cycle Specialist + Controller Integration Engineer

sessions.intent: Create unified cycle parameter pipeline: feature geometry → cycle type selection → factory defaults → controller-specific adjustments → validated parameters ready for toolpath generation. This pipeline answers 'what cycle should I use and what are its starting parameters?' for any hyperMILL operation.

units.title: Wire CycleCatalog → CycleDefaults → ControllerCatalog parameter chain
units.description: Create HyperMillCycleParameterPipeline that chains: geometry feature → CycleCatalogEngine (select cycle type from 120+) → CycleDefaultsEngine (load 138 factory defaults for selected cycle) → ControllerCatalogEngine (adjust for controller capabilities: axis count, interpolation type, canned cycle support). Output: validated parameter set ready for hyperMILL job creation.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: HyperMillCycleParameterPipeline chains all 3 engines correctly
120+ cycle types selectable by geometry feature
138 factory defaults load per cycle type
Controller-specific adjustments applied (16 CNC families)
4 unit tests: drilling, 3D roughing, 5-axis, turning cycle chains

units.title: Wire ThreadStandardEngine + build cycle-defaults-validation hook
units.description: Wire HyperMillThreadStandardEngine's 11 thread standards (ISO, ANSI, BSP, UNC, UNF, BSPT, NPT, Whitworth, Metric Fine, Trapezoidal, ACME) into the cycle parameter pipeline for thread milling and tapping cycles. Build hypermill-cycle-defaults-validation hook that validates cycle parameters against factory defaults (warn if > 30% deviation, block if physically impossible).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: 11 thread standards accessible through cycle pipeline
Tap drill size calculation uses FormulaRegistry (not hardcoded)
hypermill-cycle-defaults-validation hook registered and firing
Hook warns on > 30% deviation from factory defaults
Hook blocks physically impossible parameters (negative stepdown, zero feed)
3 unit tests: ISO thread + tap drill, ANSI thread, hook validation

units.title: Build unified cycle recommendation action with physics integration
units.description: Create cam:hypermill_cycle_recommend action that takes part feature + material + machine and returns: recommended cycle type, factory defaults, controller adjustments, AND PRISM physics-optimized parameters (speeds/feeds from SpeedFeedOrchestrator, forces from KienzleForceModel). This merges hyperMILL catalog knowledge with PRISM physics for a complete parameter recommendation.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: cam:hypermill_cycle_recommend action registered
Returns both factory defaults AND physics-optimized parameters
Physics values come from SpeedFeedOrchestrator + KienzleForceModel
Comparison table shows factory vs physics values with % difference
A machinist would accept the recommendation as a valid starting point
3 unit tests: 3D roughing in steel, drilling in aluminum, 5-axis in titanium

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ Cycle parameter pipeline chains 3 engines | ✓ 11 thread standards wired | ✓ cycle-defaults-validation hook active | ✓ cam:hypermill_cycle_recommend merges factory + physics | ✓ tsc 0 errors | ✓ 10+ tests pass | omega_floor >= 0.90 | SVI delta: +2%

knowledge: Agent 5 skills design (60 skills total, 15 Phase 1)
sessions.intent: Build 15 Phase 1 critical skills that unlock daily hyperMILL workflows. These skills are the most-used commands a machinist needs. Each skill wires to the engines and actions built in MS1-MS3. Skills are .md files with frontmatter referencing engine actions.

units.title: Build 8 core hyperMILL skills (material, speeds/feeds, drill, thread, 2D/3D strategy, rough, finish)
units.description: Create 8 skills: /hypermill-material-lookup (wire to MaterialBridge), /hypermill-speeds-feeds (wire to SpeedFeedOrchestrator), /hypermill-drill (wire to CycleCatalog drilling), /hypermill-thread (wire to ThreadStandardEngine), /hypermill-2d-strategy (wire to StrategyEngine 2D), /hypermill-3d-strategy (enhance existing), /hypermill-rough (wire to CycleDefaults roughing), /hypermill-finish (wire to CycleDefaults finishing). Each skill has frontmatter with model/effort/context/allowed-tools.
